; Quick language switch for the on-screen keyboard.
;  - Tap the globe key: switch to the language used before the current one.
;  - Hold the globe key: open the full language list (the stock behaviour of a tap).
;  - Until two languages have been used, a tap opens the list as before.
; The previous language is kept in /home/root/.config/remarkable/keyboard-previous-language.
; Written for reMarkable OS 3.28.
; Install: /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/keyboardQuickSwitch.qmd
